en: Sepia-toned early 20th‑century street scene showing an open-top automobile covered in flowers and branches, carrying a uniformed driver and several women in light-colored dresses and hats. The car is part of a formal procession or celebration, with many spectators in period clothing lining a broad cobblestone street flanked by multi‑story stone buildings and trees. The architecture appears Central or Eastern European. There is a small printed mark in the lower right corner.
